# Stepper

**Figma:** Stepper-Bar/Horizontal, Stepper-Bar/Vertical, .Primitives/Stepper/* (page 1625:3394)  
**Import:** `import { Stepper } from "@zen/design-system";`

Shows progress through a multi-step, sequential process and where the user is in it.

## Use it for
- Checkouts, onboarding, imports and setup wizards with 2–7 ordered steps.
- Vertical beside the step content when steps have longer titles or captions.
- Read-only status trackers (order shipped) with Style=Icon.

## Use something else for
- Switching between peer views → Tabs or Segmented.
- Showing a percentage → Progress.
- A single step → no stepper.

## Figma → React
| Figma | Prop | Values / notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Orientation | `orientation` | horizontal · vertical — vertical: the bar starts at its first marker and ends at its last (no hidden outer line space); each step's title + caption centres on its marker, middle steps keep Figma's 82px |
| Steps | `steps[] {id, title, caption, icon, error}` | Title Body/Base/Bold · Caption Caption/Regular |
| Current | `current` | earlier = Passed (check), current = Focused (ring), later = Default |
| Error | `step.error` | State=Error: negative marker, ring and lines |
| Navigation | `onStepClick` | Passed/Focused/Error steps become buttons |
| Steps slot | `children: <StepperStep id title caption icon error />` | instead of steps; it renders nothing alone, Stepper draws each state from current |

## Props
Generated from the TypeScript source; full JSON in `docs/api/stepper.json`.

### Stepper
Figma Stepper-Bar/Horizontal (1625:8328) and Stepper-Bar/Vertical (1625:8656) built from Step-Horizontal / Step-Vertical: a marker between two 2px progress lines (Neutral/Subtle ahead, Neutral/Solid behind, Negative/Solid on error) with Title + Caption (gap 3XSmall, padding-inline XSmall).

Also accepts `HTMLAttributes<HTMLOListElement>`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ref` | `Ref<HTMLOListElement>` | — | The root `<ol>`. |
| `steps` | `StepperStep[]` | — | The steps as data. Or give StepperStep children (Figma Stepper-Bar's steps): `<StepperStep id="details" title="Details" />`. |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | — | The steps as StepperStep elements, in order, when `steps` is not given. Stepper still draws each one's state from `current`, the progress lines and the click behaviour. |
| `current` | `number` | `0` | Index of the current step (State=Focused). Earlier steps are Passed, later ones Default. |
| `orientation` | `"horizontal" \| "vertical"` | `"horizontal"` | Figma Stepper-Bar/Horizontal or Stepper-Bar/Vertical. |
| `onStepClick` | `(step: StepperStep, index: number) => void` | — | Makes Passed/Focused/Error steps clickable (e.g. to go back and edit). Default steps stay inert. |
| `aria-label` | `string` | — | Names the list (default "Progress", from the locale's labels). |
| `className` | `string` | — |  |

### StepperItem
Figma .Primitives/Stepper/Item (1625:4827): 24px marker — number (Style=Text) or icon (Style=Icon).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `state` | `"default" \| "focused" \| "passed" \| "error"` | `"default"` |  |
| `index` | `number` | `1` |  |
| `icon` | `IconName \| ReactElement` | — |  |

### Types
Object shapes the props above refer to.

```ts
interface StepperStep { id: string; title: ReactNode; caption?: ReactNode; icon?: IconName | ReactElement; error?: boolean; }
```

## Keyboard
| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Tab / Shift+Tab | Move between reachable steps |
| Enter / Space | Go back to a passed step (onStepClick) |

## ✅ Do
- Name the process with aria-label (harness: stepper/needs-label).
- Keep 2–7 steps with short noun titles (harness: stepper/step-count).
- Let users click back to passed steps to edit; keep future steps inert.
- Mark a failed step with error and explain the fix next to it (Inline Message).

## ❌ Don't
- Don't let users skip ahead to unvisited steps unless every step is optional.
- Don't use a stepper for navigation between unrelated pages.
- Don't hide the current step's title on small screens; switch to vertical instead.

## Accessibility
- Ordered list with aria-label; the current step has aria-current=step; Passed and Error add hidden “(completed)” / “(error)” text.

## Content
- Titles are nouns ("Shipping"); captions add the detail ("Address", "Optional").

## Harness (`npm run usage:check`)
| Rule | Severity | Checks | Suppress with |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `stepper/needs-label` | warn | A Stepper needs an aria-label naming the process ("Checkout"). | `zen-allow-stepper-label: <reason>` |
| `stepper/step-count` | warn | Steppers hold 2–7 steps; one step is not a process, more than 7 needs grouping. | `zen-allow-step-count: <reason>` |
| `icon/unknown-name` | error | Icon names must exist (1,598 names that follow the Figma layer path, e.g. icon-search-medium-line); search them instead of guessing (MCP search_icons, or the Iconography page). | `zen-allow-icon-name: <reason>` |
| `interaction/no-noop-handler` | warn | Every interaction a Zen control offers works: no no-op handlers (`() => {}`, `() => undefined`), which leave a field that ignores typing and ↑/↓ or a Dismiss that stays. Chat has chat/no-locked-interaction. | `zen-allow-noop-handler: <reason>` |
